communications.subject: Oklahoma Open Records Act Request: Public Request Ledger
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Oklahoma Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

electronic log or ledger of **all public records requests received by your agency from November 9, 2024, through November 9, 2026.**

Specifically, I request the following information, where available:

1. Date each request was submitted.
2. Name of the requester, if recorded and publicly disclosable.
3. Description & subject of what was requested.
4. Status of the request (open, completed, denied, etc.).

**I am not requesting copies of the original requests, supporting documents, or records provided in response.** I am only seeking the existing tracking log or ledger showing what information was requested. If log contains additional information that can be released to save time that is ok.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

AJ Keys
